answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The sparrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the tide of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the comet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, capped per identity per epoch, each submission carries a fresh nonce.
